family.description: Members of this family include ATP-NAD kinases [ec:2.7.1.23], which catalyses the phosphorylation of NAD to NADP utilising ATP and other nucleoside triphosphates as well as inorganic polyphosphate as a source of phosphorus. Also includes NADH kinases [ec:2.7.1.86].

causal_graphs.context: Compare WT and N75T at 37 C with 5 mM ATP, 5 mM NAD+, 5 mM MgCl2, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 5 mM glucose 6-phosphate and 0.5 U glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase. Specific activity is normalized to Bradford protein concentration with BSA standard; the article defines U as umol NADP+ per minute. Figure 2 reports means and SD of three independent experiments. Exact assay enzyme dose, volume and initial-rate window are not fully specified in the inspected 2013 protocol.

evidence.explanation: Visually inspected Figure 2, ATP data in supplemental S2, main Results and assay Methods support lower ATP-associated specific activity while preserving residual output.
Places N75 in the mapped domain while distinguishing the intact recombinant construct and unresolved historical-primer discrepancies from the database reference.

edges.mechanism: N75T has lower specific activity than WT in the matched ATP-dependent assay. The retained direction concerns the intact purified reaction system; it does not assert complete ATP loss or a uniquely established atomic cause.
edges.subject: nadk-n75t-atp-comparison

causal_graphs.family_mapping: K12 reference UniProtKB:P0A7B3, nadK/yfjB/yfjE, b2615/JW2596, is 292 aa and sequence version 1; its sequence matches InterPro. PF01513 spans 8-121 and contains N75 of GGDGN at 71-75. The inherited pET-14b construct derives from MG1655 according to the cited 2001 cloning paper and is expressed without a tag in BL21(DE3)pLysS. Historical primers differ at N2/D2 and at the translated C terminus from the current reference; the 2013 alignment shows the reference-like N terminus, but complete assay clones remain unverified.
causal_graphs.limitations: This is a net coupled-assay mutation effect, not proof of a particular ATP-binding or phosphate-transfer microstep. Activity remains measurable with N75T. Independent purification batches and mutant folding/oligomer equivalence are not established. Figure S4 shows expression extracts, not purified enzyme. The displayed HTML/XML kinetic table has inconsistent ratios; exact repaired kcat/Km values are not adopted.

causal_graphs.context: At 37 C, the G6PD-coupled assay contains 5 mM tetrapolyphosphate, 5 mM NAD+, 5 mM MgCl2, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 5 mM glucose 6-phosphate and 0.5 U G6PD. Protein-normalized activities are compared within this donor condition, not directly equated to heterogeneous-polymer mass concentrations. Means/SD reflect three independent experiments; exact enzyme dose and rate window remain unspecified.

evidence.explanation: Figure 2 and supplemental Figure S3 were visually inspected; the poly(P)4 comparison and main Methods establish the donor concentration and scoped direction.

edges.mechanism: The N75T preparation produces a larger protein-normalized coupled-assay signal than WT with tetrapolyphosphate. Supplementary substrate-series data support the direction without establishing that every polyphosphate or every family member behaves similarly.
edges.subject: nadk-n75t-poly4-comparison

causal_graphs.family_mapping: P0A7B3 is the 292-aa K12 reference matching InterPro; N75 lies within PF01513 residues 8-121. The 2013 untagged pET-14b_ecoNADK preparations are full-length proteins expressed in BL21(DE3)pLysS, not isolated domains. The cited MG1655-derived parent plasmid has unresolved printed-primer differences from the current reference.
causal_graphs.limitations: WT has small nonzero activity in this assay, so the effect is an increase rather than creation of activity from a proven zero. Tripolyphosphate does not show the same increase for E. coli N75T. Coupled output does not resolve donor-binding geometry, unique molecular mediation or physiological polyphosphate use; exact kinetic-table repair remains open.

causal_graphs.context: G6PD-coupled reactions at 37 C use 1 mg/ml hexameta(P)n, 5 mM NAD+, 5 mM MgCl2, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 5 mM glucose 6-phosphate and 0.5 U G6PD. Specific activity is normalized to Bradford protein; means and SD are reported for three independent experiments. This commercial reagent is a mixture of chain lengths, not an assumed pure six-unit molecule.

evidence.explanation: Visually inspected Figure 2 and the donor-specific Results establish the increase; Methods explicitly identify hexameta(P)n as a chain-length mixture.

edges.mechanism: N75T has greater measured specific activity than WT using the same commercial hexametaphosphate mixture. The mutation effect is observed at the biochemical-assay level without assigning a chain-length-specific binding mechanism.
edges.subject: nadk-n75t-hexameta-comparison

causal_graphs.family_mapping: P0A7B3 reference N75 lies in the GGDGN motif within PF01513 8-121 of the 292-aa intact enzyme. The untagged MG1655-derived pET-14b lineage was expressed in BL21(DE3)pLysS; current reference identity is not a claim that historical primer and full-clone discrepancies have been resolved.
causal_graphs.limitations: Increased activity is relative to a nonzero WT signal and does not identify which polymer lengths supply phosphate. Exact enzyme dose, assay volume and rate window are incompletely reported; folding and oligomer equivalence are unestablished. This is not an exact donor-affinity measurement, isolated-domain sufficiency or cellular flux.

causal_graphs.context: Compare WT and N75T at 37 C with 1 mg/ml meta(P)n, 5 mM NAD+, 5 mM MgCl2, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 5 mM glucose 6-phosphate and 0.5 U G6PD. Means/SD of three independent experiments describe protein-normalized specific activity. The metaphosphate reagent contains various polymer lengths; exact assay enzyme dose, volume and rate window are not fully specified.

evidence.explanation: Visually inspected Figure 2, its caption, main Results and Methods support the donor-specific increase rather than relying solely on Figure 1's relative-to-ATP bars.

edges.mechanism: N75T increases protein-normalized activity in the metaphosphate condition compared with WT. This direction is measured independently of expressing the result as a ratio to ATP-dependent activity and is confined to the tested mixture and intact protein.
edges.subject: nadk-n75t-meta-comparison

causal_graphs.family_mapping: The targeted N75 is within PF01513 8-121 of sequence-version-1 reference P0A7B3. Whole untagged recombinant enzyme retains all other regions. The 2013 source reports sequence-confirmed mutation of its inherited pET-14b construct, but no full sequence independently resolves the older primer/reference differences.
causal_graphs.limitations: The matched WT signal is small but nonzero. A higher meta(P)n/ATP ratio also reflects lower ATP activity and is not the same quantity as this absolute donor-specific increase. Separate TLC supports product formation but does not retroactively supply this assay's rate window. No atomic donor-recognition mechanism, physiological donor switch or universal GGDGN rule is inferred.

causal_graphs.context: Incubate 5-ul reactions for 10 h at 37 C with 5 mM NAD+, 5 mM MgCl2, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 1 mg/ml meta(P)n and 0.43 ug/ml enzyme. TLC uses isobutyrate/500 mM NH4OH at 5:3 and UV detection at 254 nm. Displayed no-enzyme reactions and NAD+, NADP+, ATP and ADP standards establish the comparison; the ATP lanes are separate donor conditions.

evidence.explanation: Figure 3 was visually inspected with its lane key, caption and TLC Methods. The adopted edge is qualitative and retains the distinct ten-hour, 5-ul product assay.

edges.mechanism: The N75T metaphosphate reaction displays a stronger NADP+-position spot than the corresponding WT reaction; no-enzyme and nucleotide-standard lanes constrain its interpretation. This directly observed product-associated endpoint is not converted into an exact rate or a structural mechanism.
edges.subject: nadk-n75t-meta-tlc-comparison

causal_graphs.family_mapping: The untagged intact ecoNADK/N75T constructs map to P0A7B3 with N75 inside PF01513 8-121. MG1655-derived plasmid lineage and BL21(DE3)pLysS expression are distinguished from current K12 reference sequence and unresolved historical terminal-primer differences.
causal_graphs.limitations: The stronger spot co-migrates with NADP+ but is not independently identified by mass spectrometry or NMR. The image supplies neither a calibrated product yield nor independent replicate uncertainty. Ten-hour product accumulation is not an initial rate or complete substrate conversion; no cellular production advantage, all-polyphosphate transfer or atomically resolved specificity change is inferred.

record.description: Members of this family include ATP-NAD kinases [ec:2.7.1.23], which catalyses the phosphorylation of NAD to NADP utilising ATP and other nucleoside triphosphates as well as inorganic polyphosphate as a source of phosphorus. Also includes NADH kinases [ec:2.7.1.86].

evidence.explanation: Main Methods/Results/Discussion and supplemental captions/table were read, with Figures 2/3 and S1-S4 visually inspected. Exact table-ratio reconciliation, donor distributions, full clones, mutant assembly and purification replicates remain unresolved. S4 is an expression-extract gel. Vibrio's K2E engineering and other proteins must be separately mapped before transferring any effect.

The parent-plasmid study identifies MG1655 but its printed forward and reverse primers differ from the present reference. Its stopped isocitrate-dehydrogenase assay, nmol/min units and undetected polyphosphate activity are not interchangeable with the 2013 G6PD assay and small WT signals. No older-paper figures were independently visually reviewed.

discussions.notes: Other mutations, microbial/archaeal/eukaryotic homologs, immobilized-cell yield and cyanobacterial phenotypes remain outside this partial assessment. The 2013 phylogenetic narrative is not an observed causal chain. Preserve terminal-primer uncertainty and differing KND/KNDE buffer descriptions instead of silently repairing the sources. Partial scientific self-review; IN_PROGRESS.
discussions.prompt: Resolve NADK construct and kinetic-table discrepancies before extending donor-recognition or physiological mechanisms.
discussions.rationale: N75T has donor-specific effects in intact purified protein. Coupled assays and TLC do not establish a unique residue-level binding geometry, universal family donor preference or a cellular redox mechanism.
